subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: How should maintainers split and assign this bundled session-routing report across TUI session defaults, meaningful activity ordering, WeChat plugin/core routing, and background-event isolation?
rationale: The source gaps are real, but the correct fix boundaries cross core Gateway/TUI, Control UI, external WeChat plugin ownership, and session activity taxonomy, so automation should not choose one architecture for all four behaviors.

options.title: Split into focused tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, route meaningful activity to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, and require live WeChat proof plus separate TUI/background-event decisions before code work.

options.title: Queue one broad refactor
options.body: Attempt one large session-routing refactor, accepting higher review risk and likely product churn across unrelated surfaces.

options.title: Close as partially addressed
options.body: Close around the merged selector fix and rely on narrower existing or future reports for the remaining behaviors, risking loss of the unresolved TUI and flood evidence.

recommendation.title: Split into focused tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, route meaningful activity to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, and require live WeChat proof plus separate TUI/background-event decisions before code work.
